headline: Deep sequence models are designing and predicting mRNA and small RNA properties
label: Generative Biomolecular Design
summary: Recent preprints extend language and deep models to mRNA design, stability and RNA regulation prediction with explicit biological constraints.
synthesis: The dominant thread is deep sequence modeling of RNA, using language-model and neural architectures under explicit biological context. Pro2RNA and RNASTOP are design-oriented: Pro2RNA generates species-aware mRNA coding sequences from protein input, while RNASTOP couples deep learning with heuristic search to optimize chemical stability, reporting a 13% accuracy gain on OpenVaccine data. Other items are predictive: miRBind2 uses a CNN with pairwise nucleotide encoding for miRNA target sites, EvoRMD jointly predicts eleven RNA modification types using an evolutionary RNA language model with metadata, and NMDetective-AI pairs a genomic language model with deep mutational scanning to map NMD escape. What is new is the application of these architectures to mRNA-level objectives such as stability, species specificity and graded decay.
